$comment: Tests written ahead of their feature: each must FAIL until the feature is in, then come off this list. See tests/README.md (red first). Only new tests belong here; the floor guard refuses an existing test listed as pending.

pending.test: lantern hunt: the scene has 12 floating lanterns with stable indices, at every board size
lantern hunt: positions are judged on the frame's own ambient tick
lantern hunt: a click counts within 7 art px of a lantern and not beyond
lantern hunt: of two lanterns close together a click takes the nearest unlit one
lantern hunt: a lit lantern isn't found again, and open water finds nothing
lantern hunt: a lantern off screen can't be clicked
lantern hunt: no lantern's click box ever touches a playable point, at any board size
lantern hunt: with reduced motion the goal is the lanterns on screen, so it can be reached
lantern hunt: a lit lantern changes the picture round it and stays in the palette
lantern festival: it lasts 34 seconds
lantern festival: every screen gets the same seed from the room and who lit it
lantern festival: the same seed gives the same layout, and another seed another
lantern festival: every lantern comes to rest on the right or bottom border, touching no number
lantern festival: every lantern starts on open water
lantern festival: lanterns keep their distance, at rest and in the water
lantern festival: the layout looks irregular: no gap over 100 px, no more than 3 neighbours in line, at least 2 a side
lantern festival: nothing shows before it starts or after it ends
lantern festival: at its height every lantern is on the border, and the kaya is untouched throughout
lantern festival: with reduced motion the lanterns simply sit on the border until it ends
lantern card: its face is a card-sized sprite of its own, and the market can't sell it
lantern festival: a seated player's message goes to the whole table, with their colour and name
lantern festival: a seat gets one festival a game
lantern festival: a client without a seat starts nothing
lantern festival: a second seat during a festival is told to wait, and may go when it is over
lantern festival: a player in the waiting room can start one
lantern festival: the game state is byte for byte the same before and after
lantern festival over the wire: all four clients at a table receive it, with who lit it
lantern festival over the wire: a flood of messages from one seat makes one festival
lantern card: a click on a floating lantern lights it, and tells the server nothing
lantern card: clicking a lit lantern changes nothing
lantern card: a lantern clicked while looking back counts, with no recall warning
lantern card: lighting the last lantern puts the card in the hand, and the hunt sent nothing to the server
lantern card: it takes up no place in the hand and arms nothing while it waits
lantern card: the find is kept per seat and room
lantern card: the card survives a reload, and every lantern stays lit
lantern card: playing it sends one message, leaves the hand when the server answers, and changes nothing in the game
lantern card: while the festival runs the scene is drawn with it on every frame
lantern card: a card already played stays gone after a reload
lantern card: another player's festival plays here too, with a notice naming them
